description: This file implements PNG filtering algorithms for PDF processing, including unfiltering methods and the Paeth predictor, as part of the PDFsharp library.

classes.name: PngFilter
classes.description: A static class providing PNG filtering and unfiltering methods according to the PNG specification.

methods.name: Unfilter
methods.description: Performs PNG unfiltering on input data based on the filter type, reconstructing the original scanline data.

methods.name: PaethPredictor
methods.description: Calculates the Paeth predictor value used in PNG filtering to estimate pixel values.
